commit.message:
fix: accept ordinary foods and compose halfwidth voiced marks

Word-boundary matching and phrase exceptions stop short fragments from
rejecting normal public food names. Halfwidth dakuten and handakuten are
composed before NFKC on both the app and the server. Rollback SQL lives
under supabase/rollback, and a rejected publish leaves the local row private.

Co-authored-by: naruto-aii <naruto-aii@users.noreply.github.com>

as well as name. Fold Unicode NFKC, combining marks, accents, Cyrillic
lookalikes, and digit or symbol substitutions before matching.

commit.message:
fix: pin public food SQL functions to an empty search_path

publish_saved_food is SECURITY DEFINER, and the seven helpers and the public-row trigger used search_path = public. They now use an empty search_path and schema-qualified names. The rollback file still restores the previous definitions.

Co-authored-by: naruto-aii <naruto-aii@users.noreply.github.com>

commit.message:
fix: reject explicit compound names without blocking ordinary foods

Longer explicit compounds match as whole terms, including when a food word is attached. Short fragments stay boundary-only, so names such as cafe latte and smoked salt still pass.

Co-authored-by: naruto-aii <naruto-aii@users.noreply.github.com>
